opportunities.name: United flight search from homepage booking form
opportunities.description: On united.com, search flights from a given origin to a destination for given dates, trip type, passengers, cabin and award option, then optionally pick a fare.
steps: Open united.com Book > Flight tab
Choose Roundtrip or One-way; tick 'Book with miles' if needed
Type origin city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Type destination city and pick the matching airport suggestion
Open the Dates picker, page to the right month, click depart (and return) dates
Open Travelers and adjust adults/children counts
Choose cabin (Economy / Premium economy / Business)
Click Find flights
Optionally adjust date on results page and select a fare/view details

instances.values: One-way, book with miles, Sacramento SMF -> Houston IAH, Jun 2, 1 adult
Roundtrip, Baltimore BWI -> New York NYC, Aug 2 - Aug 7, 2 adults, Economy
Roundtrip, Pune PNQ -> New York NYC, Jun 9 - Jun 11, 1 adult; selected Economy fully refundable $2,984

Roundtrip, Santa Fe SAF -> Phoenix PHX, Aug 13 - Aug 28, 1 adult; selected $681 Economy

opportunities.name: TripAdvisor restaurant search by location with filter
opportunities.description: On TripAdvisor, open Restaurants, search for a location, and apply a cuisine, dietary or feature filter to the restaurant list.
steps: Click Restaurants on the TripAdvisor home page
Type the location in the 'Where to?' search box
Select the matching location suggestion
(Optional) Click 'More restaurants in <place>' to reach the full list
Click 'Show more' in the relevant filter group if needed
Tick the desired filter (cuisine, dietary restriction, feature) and Apply
Optionally limit results to the city, open a restaurant, or save it to a Trip

instances.values: Central Park New York; Cuisine = Italian
Los Angeles; Cuisine = Indian; limited to LA, opened Urban Masala, saved to new trip 'Los Angeles'
Big Sur, CA; Feature = Outdoor Seating

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search
opportunities.description: On SpotHero, search parking at a venue for a specific event, optionally filter (e.g. wheelchair accessible), adjust entry/exit times or sort, and book a spot.
steps: Type venue name in 'Search for parking' and pick the venue suggestion
In the venue events modal, optionally pick an event date, then click the event
Click Filter, tick desired amenity (e.g. Wheelchair Accessible) and click Show results
Adjust Enter After / Exit Before times and click Update Search
Change sort (Distance / Price) if needed
Click Book Now on the chosen spot

instances.values: Barclays Center; Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets; 3:00 PM - 5:00 PM; Book Now on 201 S Portland Ave
Busch Stadium; Pirates at Cardinals (Apr 13); Wheelchair Accessible; Sort by Price
Barclays Center; date Apr 9; 76ers at Brooklyn Nets; Wheelchair Accessible; start 10:00 AM

opportunities.name: United map search (Explore destinations)
opportunities.description: On United's Explore destinations map, set a departure city plus trip type, dates and max price, then search to see fares by destination.
steps: Open BOOK > Map search (Explore destinations)
Type the departure city in 'Flying from' and pick the airport suggestion
Set trip type (Roundtrip) and dates (Flexible dates / exact)
Optionally set max price
Click Search and view the list of search results

instances.values: Phoenix PHX; Roundtrip; Flexible dates; $2000; opened list of results
Las Vegas LAS; Roundtrip; Flexible Dates (next 30 days); $2000
